subject: general
question: Who became the first individual to surpass a net worth of $700 billion?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Elon Musk.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Elon Musk becomes the first individual to surpass a net worth of $700 billion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forbes Billionaires Index estimates Musk’s net worth at $749 billion.**
 
• **Fortune surged after Delaware Supreme Court reinstated a Tesla stock options package.**
 
• **This marks a historic milestone in individual wealth worldwide.**
 
• **Elon Musk is a tech billionaire and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Forbes Billionaires Index** – Annual ranking of the world’s richest individuals based on net worth.
 
• **Tesla Stock Options** – Incentive packages granted to executives, contributing to Musk’s wealth.
 
• **Delaware Supreme Court** – Court that reinstated Musk’s Tesla stock options package.
 
• **Net Worth** – Total assets minus liabilities of an individual, representing overall wealth.
